meta.title: NovaFlow account
meta.description: Sign in to NovaFlow in your browser and save connections in native Settings → Models. Edit models and supported reasoning levels there; signing out retains model configuration. Built-in media MCP defaults images to gpt-image-2.6 and requires a user-selected video model, without Magpie setup. View balance on NovaFlow.

ui.title: NovaFlow account
ui.intro: Sign in to NovaFlow to save the connection in Settings → Models. No API key copying is needed.
ui.pendingHelp: Complete sign-in and confirm authorization on NovaFlow. This page updates automatically when authorization finishes.
ui.popupHelp: If no browser page opened, use the authorization link below.
ui.cancelled: Authorization cancelled. You can sign in again when ready.
ui.failed: Authorization did not finish. Please try again.
ui.modelsHelp: Your connection is saved in Settings → Models. Fetch, add, or edit models in the NovaFlow provider.
ui.balanceUnknown: Balance is not provided by this connection. Check your current balance on NovaFlow.
ui.signoutConfirm: Sign out of NovaFlow and clear the local sign-in credentials? Native provider and model configuration will remain for your next sign-in. Running requests may be interrupted.
ui.warning: Account synchronization needs attention. Refresh to retry or check your permissions on NovaFlow.
ui.networkError: Could not reach the account service or NovaFlow. Check your network connection and try again.
ui.genericError: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
ui.authorizationError: NovaFlow authorization was rejected or expired. Please sign in again.
ui.conflictError: A managed model connection has changed. Review the connection settings before syncing again.
ui.unavailableError: NovaFlow is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
ui.protocolError: The account service returned an unexpected response. Please refresh or restart Harness.
ui.reconnectHelp: Earlier device credentials are still saved locally. Sign out to clear them, then sign in again. Provider and model configuration will remain.
ui.revokeFailed: You are signed out locally, but remote device revocation failed. Revoke this device in NovaFlow Security and access.
ui.syncRetryHelp: Your connection is saved, but account synchronization has not finished. Refresh to retry without signing in again.
ui.cleanupFailed: Sign-in credentials were cleared or have expired, but local connection cleanup did not finish. Native provider and model configuration will remain. Sign in again or restart Harness and retry.
ui.cleanupAndRevokeFailed: You are signed out locally, but connection cleanup and remote device revocation did not finish. Native provider and model configuration will remain. Restart Harness and revoke this device in NovaFlow Security and access.
ui.modelThinkingHelp: In each model’s Advanced settings, configure the reasoning levels it supports. Then choose the reasoning depth for the current conversation in its model picker.
ui.modelConnectionHelp: Claude models use Anthropic Messages; other models use OpenAI Responses. Keep the local connection address supplied by the plugin. Manage sign-in and refresh in Account and balance; no API key copying is needed.
ui.modelFooterHelp: Signing in to NovaFlow saves native provider configuration here. Use the editors above to fetch, add, or edit models. Signing out keeps this configuration, but model requests require you to sign in again.
ui.setupIntro: NovaFlow offers these five plugins after sign-in. The official DSH installer runs only after you confirm.
ui.setupPolicy: Installed packages are skipped, disabled packages stay disabled, and existing versions are not upgraded.
ui.setupRestartHelp: Some changes require restarting DeepSeek Harness. Save your work and restart the app when ready.
ui.setupRuntimeMissing: The bundled DSH package runtime is missing or cannot start. Repair or reinstall the complete official DSH desktop app, restart, then retry. Changing the registry cannot restore missing runtime files.
ui.setupNetwork: The registry could not be reached or the request timed out. Check the network and retry.
ui.setupPermission: The install directory is inaccessible or a file is locked. Check permissions, security software, and other DSH processes.
ui.setupIncompatible: This plugin version is incompatible with DSH. Choose a compatible version in the official plugin manager.
ui.setupBuildBlocked: The official installer blocked build scripts. Review them in the official plugin manager; they are not approved automatically.
ui.setupDiskFull: There is not enough free disk space. Free space and retry.
ui.setupGenericFailure: Installation did not finish. Check the official plugin manager error or logs, then retry.
ui.setupStatusUnavailable: Automatic installation status is not available yet. Refresh the account and retry.
ui.installConfirmHelp: After confirmation, the official DSH installer checks and installs these five packages using registry.npmmirror.com. Installed packages are skipped and disabled choices are preserved.
ui.installRunningHelp: Installation is running in the background. Per-plugin status updates below. Closing this window does not cancel an admitted installation.
ui.installResultHelp: Results are shown below. To retry, confirm installation again.
ui.installExpired: The confirmation expired. Refresh the account and open the installation dialog again.
